September 1, 2026


A warm welcome, great conversations and a celebration of culture. ❤️ In late July, we were honoured to attend the Stanley Mission Community Gathering, where we enjoyed traditional foods, admired the work of talented local artisans and took in lively jigging and square-dancing competitions. We also appreciated the opportunity to connect with LLRIB leadership and community members to share updates on our operations and the 2025 Collaboration Agreement. A special thank you to our hosts for the warm welcome, and to Ron Hyggen and Jen Thoma from Kitsaki for making the trip north with us.[#CommunityConnections](https://facebook.com/hashtag/CommunityConnections)
